Include exactly 13 numbers in the response. In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with ease.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of future forensics to leave clues that will aid her modern colleagues in catching The Timekeeper. But with the clock ticking down, Rachel must also confront the killer himself, who seems to always be one step ahead.

With the help of a local detective, Jack, Rachel must use her skills to unravel the mystery of The Timekeeper's true identity and motivations. But as the body count rises, Rachel realizes that she may be the only one who can stop him - and that the key to catching him lies in the very fabric of time itself.

As the stakes grow higher, Rachel must use all her knowledge of future forensics to leave a trail of clues that will lead her modern colleagues to The Timekeeper's next victim. But with only 13 days left before The Timekeeper dies, Rachel must act fast - or risk losing the chance to catch him once and for all. Can she solve the mystery of The Timekeeper before it's too late, or will she become the next victim of the time-hopping serial killer?"
